---
title: "Reports"
---

Working artefacts for delineating GWAS Catalog full-summary-statistic analyses
into candidate OpenGWASDB stores, and deciding what to build first. Their sources
are in `docs/reports/`; the pages linked here are the committed, self-contained
HTML the site copies as it is, so a report is refreshed with `pixi run docs` and
never re-executed at render time.

### [Progress update, October 2026](progress-2026-10.html) {#progress}

*Report.* Where OpenGWASDB stands: build, reference-completion and query cost
across Dense, Ragged and Hybrid stores; how a store holds an association in about
2 bytes; MR and regional-plot positive controls with and without imputed
variants; how a Release Bundle drives the Snakemake build; and the twelve Store
Releases built so far.

### [Getting started with stores](query-walkthrough.html) {#walkthrough}

*Guide.* Start here if you've never opened a store: a hands-on command-line tour
of the four pilot stores — what a store contains, the five `opengwasdb query-*`
commands, how to turn their output into readable tables, and the gotchas that
catch everyone first time.

### [Store curation report](store-curation.html) {#curation}

*Report.* How 171,274 full-sumstats analyses split into dense, ragged, and hybrid
candidate stores — grouped by publication and dominant ancestry, ragged stores
labelled by molecular type, with reference-completed size estimates and the
EUR-hybrid EFO-clustered prioritisation.

### [Canonical trait mapping](trait-mapping-report.html) {#trait-mapping}

*Analysis.* The BioLORD + Jev pipeline that maps free-text trait labels to EFO
terms: validation against GWAS Catalog curation (OGS-00011, ~99% estimated
precision at the promotion threshold), the first ukb-b round (409 rows
auto-accepted), and the defects only live runs exposed.

### [UKB-B trait mapping round 2](trait-mapping-ukb-b-round2.md) {#trait-mapping-round-2}

*Analysis.* The issue #185 rerun over 2,093 remaining labels: Showcase context,
ICD-10 retrieval, top-100 shortlists, 141 new mappings, the fresh 845-label
review queue, bucket movement, regression checks, and a published random spot
check.

### [Prioritisation dashboard](prioritisation-dashboard.html) {#dashboard}

*Interactive tool.* Drag each store card into High / Low / Discard columns; each
column tallies its store count, analyses, and estimated storage. Filter, sort,
and export the prioritisation to CSV. Your layout is saved in the browser.

### [Imputation-quality filters](imputation-filters.html) {#imputation-filters}

*Analysis.* Choosing MAF and imputation-r² cutoffs before importing dense
TOPMed-imputed summary statistics — r² by MAF bin, a retention grid of variants
kept versus store size, and a worked tiered-threshold proposal.

### [EUR LD panel comparison](eur-panel-imputation-comparison.html) {#eur-panel}

*Analysis.* Paired masking experiment across five UKB-B regions comparing
held-out beta recovery with the UKB EUR and matched HGDP+1kGP EUR LD panels.

### [Beta-scale estimation](beta-scale-estimation.html) {#beta-scale}

*Analysis.* A quick simulation of phenotype-SD estimation from random
common-variant betas when source MAF is missing — comparing oracle,
reference-profile, and uniform common-MAF assumptions for EUR-like and AFR-like
GWAS.

---

The report sources and the recipes that refresh them are in
[`../docs/reports/`](../docs/reports/) and
[`pixi run docs`](../tools/build-site.sh); the data a report reads is under
[`../resources/`](../resources/).
